postings.title: AI Engineer (Core Harness)
postings.description:
Hey! We're team Granola 👋  

If you haven't already, you should check out what we're building https://www.granola.ai/, and why you should work here https://www.granola.ai/jobs.

We are looking for a self-starting engineer, passionate about applying the latest advancements in LLMs to create user-centric products.

The Core Harness team builds the systems that turn models into useful, reliable agents at Granola: the agent loop, tools, memory, context management and execution environment. We own how those pieces work together, so agents can understand a user’s work, take action across their tools and follow through on complex tasks.

As an AI Engineer on the team, you’ll work across model behaviour and the systems that shape it. That might mean deciding what an agent should remember, helping it recover when a tool fails, or redesigning its execution loop to make use of a new model’s capabilities.




WHY YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT

 - You’ve built with models and investigated their failures. You can explain where a system struggled, how you diagnosed the problem and what made it better.

 - You think across the whole agent. You’re interested in how model behaviour, context, memory, tools and execution interact, and can reason about which part needs to change.

 - You have judgment about agent/model behaviour. You notice when an agent is being unhelpful, taking unnecessary steps or acting with too little information. You care about making it feel capable, responsive and trustworthy.

 - You enjoy a field where the answers keep changing. You try new capabilities, develop your own understanding of their strengths and limitations, and revisit earlier decisions when the evidence changes.

 - Love working in a startup environment (you either have experience working in a startup or are really drawn to the zero-to-one phase)

 - Are fascinated by LLMs. You love to play with them, figure out what makes them tick and get them to do what you want. You scour the web and reddit for others doing the same (you probably follow @goodside on twitter)

In this role, you will:

 - Own the development and application of LLM-based features end-to-end

 - Build and maintain evaluation frameworks for prompt iteration and semantic retrieval

 - Optimize embeddings and vector stores for performance and scalability

 - Interact with users to understand their problems and design solutions

 - Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in LLMs and applied AI practices

 - Collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers, designers, and other members to create a cutting-edge product

Your background looks something like:

 - Engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies

 - Shipping multi-provider LLM-based solutions to production (using e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)

 - Proficiency with LLM infra platforms (prompt management, logging/tracing, evals)

 - Experience designing large-context LLM systems (RAG, knowledge graphs, hybrid search, memory)

 - Building features end-to-end with TypeScript, React.js, and Node.js

What we offer

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Mother_of_All_Demos in 1968. We want to assemble the best crew to build this future together, here in London. Our compensation philosophy is to pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity.

We do our best work in person, and so our team spends time together five days per week in our new, bright, and spacious office at Old Street. We are happy to offer relocation assistance to candidates who'll be moving to London to join us.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

postings.title: Join our Talent Pool
postings.description:
Join our Talent Pool



If you don’t see any suitable roles for you right now, but you’d potentially like to join Granola in the future, then join our Talent Pool! 



What’s a Talent Pool? 



A Talent Pool is a collection of people, just like you, who want to register their interest in joining Granola in the future. It’s a great way for us to keep in touch, for new roles, hiring events and everything else Granola. 



How does your Talent Pool work?



We don’t actively monitor or approve people into our Talent Pool, but it’s our first stop for hiring. Anyone can join, regardless of experience or skill level, and we’ll let you know as soon as we have something suitable. 



So I’ll find out about new Granola jobs before anyone else?



Yes, potentially. We’ll search and reach out to relevant people in our Talent Pool before we openly advertise any new roles. 



I’m not a Software Engineer, can I still join?



Yes, our Talent Pool is for everyone, regardless of role or seniority. We do all the filtering on our side, so you can join once and we’ll contact you when we have something suitable. 



Can I still speak with one of your team?



We’re fortunate to have a lot of incredibly talented people wanting to join Granola, applying to our live roles and our Talent Pool.



This means we’re not able to speak with everyone, but we’ll let you know if we think it’s worth mutually committing time to a call. 



How do I join your Talent Pool?



Just click ‘Apply here’, upload your CV and a few details about yourself and you’re in.

postings.title: Design Engineer
postings.description:
Hey! We’re team Granola 👋

If you haven’t already, you should check out what we’re building https://www.granola.ai/, and why you should work here https://www.granola.ai/jobs.

We're looking for a Design Engineer to bridge the gap between design and engineering, helping us craft polished, delightful, and technically excellent user experiences.

You'll be a hybrid thinker and maker, comfortable working in both Figma and code, and you'll play a critical role in evolving how Granola feels in the hands of our users.



In this role, you will:

 - Build and maintain a robust, scalable design system in both Figma and code (React, Tailwind etc.)

 - Prototype and ship high-quality, production-ready UI that nails the details — from typography and color to motion and microinteractions

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to bring new features to life, from early concept to polished implementation

 - Maintain consistency as we grow across multiple platforms (Mac, Windows, iOS)

 - Identify and fix gaps between design and engineering, raising the quality bar across the product

 - Help invent new interaction patterns for AI-driven tools



Your background looks something like:

 - Experience working as a Design Engineer, frontend engineer with strong design skills, or designer with strong engineering skills

 - Highly proficient with React, TypeScript, Tailwind and have a solid grasp of modern frontend architecture

 - Strong visual and interaction design skills — you care deeply about details, polish, and making things feel "just right"

 - Natural prototyper who's comfortable exploring in Figma, code, or AI tools, depending on what's fastest

 - Worked on (or are drawn to) design systems and component libraries, and know how to balance consistency with flexibility



As a person, you…

 - Are first and foremost a builder

 - Are excited to work in-person from our office in London (most of the time)

 - Love working in a startup environment (you either have experience working in a startup or are really drawn to the zero-to-one phase)

 - Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

 - Thrive in a fast-paced iterative startup environment where experimentation is encouraged



Why this role is special:

 - You won't just hand off designs to engineers or code up specs you didn't influence. You'll be both designing and building the Granola interface.

 - We're inventing new AI-powered workflows. This means prototyping, testing, and refining interactions that don't yet have established patterns.

 - You'll work closely with Sam (co-founder & designer), our founding designer, and our talented engineering team, all of whom care deeply about product quality. You'll have space and support to push for exceptional user experiences.



About the opportunity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Mother_of_All_Demos in 1968. We want to assemble the best crew to build this future together, here in London. Our compensation philosophy is to pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

postings.title: Account Executive, Mid Market
postings.description:
ABOUT US

We’re Team Granola 👋  building tools that help humans think and work better.

What began as an AI notepad for back-to-back meetings has become a shared team workspace and second brain. Granola spreads organically inside companies, often starting with a senior leader and quickly cascading across teams.

Today, Granola is used at many of the world’s top and fastest-growing companies like Vercel, Cursor, Lovable and Decagon.

Designed and built in London, Granola now serves a predominantly US customer base. To support that growth, we’ve opened a San Francisco office as the hub for our North American go-to-market efforts.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll help define our go-to-market approach and make an immediate contribution to revenue growth, closing deals where Granola is already loved and converting engagement into paid business.

You’ll be at the forefront of our growth: owning the sales cycle, engaging with high-potential prospects, and working closely with internal teams to deliver value to customers.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Engage with our highest-potential prospects and qualified opportunities.

 - Own the full sales cycle: from discovery to close.

 - Navigate security reviews, procurement, legal processes, and vendor management systems.

 - Help build and optimize our sales playbook and processes based on what works.

 - Conduct warm outreach to convert highly engaged free users into paid accounts..

 - Play a pivotal role in building the SF office and sales team culture.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Background & Experience

 - 3-5 years of experience as a top-performing Account Executive with a strong track record of success.

 - Proven success managing sales cycles end to end, including cross-functional stakeholder engagement (security, legal, procurement).

 - Comfortable with high-velocity sales processes.

 - Exposure to formal sales training and methodologies.
   

Skills & Traits

 - Highly autonomous with strong prioritisation skills.

 - Thrive in a startup environment where you help build processes, not just follow them.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills that build trust quickly.

 - Excited to work collaboratively across functions and time zones.
   

Personal Characteristics

 - A builder who gets energized creating something from scratch.

 - Excited to work in-person in the SF office.

 - Creative, initiative-driven, curious about customer behavior, and eager to own challenges without perfect information.

 - Values working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic.




ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together, in London and SF.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.





COMPENSATION:

OTE $200K – $260K • + equity and benefits!

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.




LOCATION

We are excited to work in-person from our office in San Francisco (most of the time). We are happy to offer relocation assistance to candidates who’ll be moving to SF to join us.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

postings.title: Customer Success Manager
postings.description:
ABOUT GRANOLA

Hey! We're team Granola 👋 We're building the leading AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings, a product that's spreading through teams and redefining how knowledge is captured and used. We help teams turn messy call notes into structured insight, so they can spend more time focusing on what's important and less time on admin.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We're growing our US Customer Success team and looking for our next CSM to join our founding US CSMs in San Francisco. You'll own a book of our highest-value enterprise accounts end-to-end, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You'll be a core part of a small, ambitious team where your work directly impacts customer experience and our US GTM motion.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own and grow a book of business across business, enterprise, and high-potential accounts, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

 - Run high-touch onboarding for strategic accounts, including custom kickoffs with Sales and Recruitment.

 - Become a deep product expert and trusted advisor to customers, helping them design workflows, best practices, and change management around AI-powered note-taking.

 - Take on technical ownership of AI integrations and setup (e.g., MCP-style integrations, AI tooling) as the product evolves.

 - Contribute to our CS playbook: processes, metrics, cadences, and how we segment and support accounts as we scale.

 - Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Leadership to bring customer insights into roadmap and go-to-market decisions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Your background looks something like…

 - 4+ years in Customer Success (ideally 5+), with at least 2 years managing a consistent book of business at the same company throughout the post-sales lifecycle (onboarding, adoption, renewal / upsell).

 - Experience in PLG / high-velocity SaaS environments (think Intercom, HubSpot, or earlier-stage Monday.com/Asana-style http://Monday.com/Asana-style products) rather than large, heavy enterprise motions.

 - Comfort working with modern SaaS and GTM stacks (e.g., Attio, Stripe, Juro, Omni). Experience with AI products & integrations is a strong plus.

 - US-based and able to work from our San Francisco office 5 days a week once we have one (no visa sponsorship available).


AS A PERSON YOU...

 - You're a builder: resourceful, self-sufficient, and excited to help shape CS processes, playbooks, and systems as we grow.

 - You're hungry and ambitious. You care about growth, impact, and taking on wide scope in a small team.

 - You're genuinely customer-obsessed: you build strong rapport, ask sharp discovery questions, and leave people feeling understood and supported.

 - You're curious about product and AI, and enjoy digging into how things work and pushing for deeper understanding.

 - You communicate clearly, collaborate well with Sales and Product, and are comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving startup.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience with AI tooling or integrations (e.g., MCP-style integrations, AI-powered workflows, or similar).

 - Experience at an earlier-stage company where you helped shape the CS function.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

postings.title: Product Designer
postings.description:
Hey! We're team Granola 👋

If you haven't already, you should check out what we're building https://www.granola.ai/, and why you should work here https://www.granola.ai/jobs.

We're looking for a Product Designer to invent the future of AI-powered work tools. You’ll share in our obsession with making the most useful product possible, especially as we evolve Granola into a multiplayer, multi-platform tool that helps with much more than just notes.

Why this role is special:

 - Invent the future of software: AI is evolving at breakneck speed, and we believe half the "best practices" of tomorrow haven't been invented yet. If you're drawn to experimentation and pioneering new interaction patterns, you'll thrive here.

 - Shape our early team: You'll shape Granola's design DNA. You won't just follow established processes; you'll create them, influencing everything from day-to-day design workflows to our long-term design culture.

 - Join a design-forward founding team: Sam (co-founder) is a designer, and Chris (co-founder) is a second-time founder https://go.granola.so/socratic with product background. We get what it means to do design right, and you'll have full support to push for great user experiences.

 - Work with kind, ambitious, and talented people: We've built an incredibly talented team of engineers and designers, with product sense and empathy for our users. Building something that's actually useful is baked into the culture of the company.

In this role, you will:

 - Work on early feature definition, and sit shoulder to shoulder with engineers to ship features and market them to the world.

 - Level up the fit & finish of our product. People spend hours each day working inside Granola; we owe it to them to make it a beautifully crafted experience.

 - Spend hours each week with users whether it’s investigating use cases, testing new features, or building your sense of what to build next.

 - Prototype, test, iterate: Jump between "explore" mode (trying wild ideas, prototyping in Figma or code with AI tools like Cursor/Claude Code) and "exploit" mode (perfecting promising features, nailing interactions, typography, and motion).

 - Evolve our brand and design language, and make sure it's applied consistently across the product.

Your background looks something like:

 - Spent at least a few years shipping beautifully designed products to real users. Think of this as a senior/staff-level role.

 - Systems thinker who's worked on open-ended tools before, not just A→B flows. You understand that architecting a flexible system is as much the challenge as executing on individual features.

 - Know when to be scrappy, and when to hone in on the details. When we're early figuring out features, speed of iteration is all that counts. As we build conviction in what we're building, it's sweating the details in interaction, typography, and motion that make all the difference.

 - A natural prototyper: let's try it and see how it feels might be one of our most used phrases in the office.

 - Drawn to figuring out problems in code and the latest AI tools: staying on the bleeding edge of AI tools is a company value for us – it's important to make us more effective, but also to incorporate the best ideas into Granola.

 - Measure your designs on what shipped, not a beautiful Figma file.

 - Comfortable working across platforms. We're building for Mac, iOS, and web, and it's important that Granola feels like a good citizen on all. An awareness of established patterns for each platform is important.

As a person, you…

 - Are first and foremost a builder

 - Are excited to work in-person from our office in London (most of the time)

 - Love working in a startup environment (you either have experience working in a startup or are really drawn to the zero-to-one phase)

 - Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

About the opportunity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Mother_of_All_Demos in 1968, and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together, here in London. Our compensation philosophy is to pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

postings.title: Affiliate and Influencer Marketer
postings.description:
Granola https://www.granola.ai/ is the AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. We're growing fast and looking for a hands-on affiliate / influencer / creator marketer to help us scale our partnership programmes across evergreen and launch campaigns. This is an individual contributor role.



THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for an affiliate and influencer marketer to join our team at Granola. We work with hundreds of creators and publishers to support acquiring new users through partnerships (sponsorships, affiliation and hybrid models).

You'll sit at the intersection of branding and growth, making sure we’re proud of the online narratives around Granola and checking the performance of our influencer marketing efforts at a channel and partner level.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own a creator portfolio : Be responsible for growing and looking after a large portfolio of key accounts (sponsored, affiliates or hybrid) and regularly keeping in touch with them to increase Granola’s presence on their different channels

 - Newsletter sponsorships : You'll own this channel end to end, from partner onboarding and booking through live-date tracking, invoicing, and performance reporting.

 - Influencer partnerships : Sourcing and onboarding great creators for authentic collaborations. Instead of an ad placement, you’ll do demos of granola, find ideas and creative briefs for the influencers that would bring new user acquisitions too

 - YouTube collaborations : Running campaigns with youtube creators to meet internal priorities through integrations, dedicated videos and editorial projects.


EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU MIGHT WORK ON

 - Newsletter creatives : draft launch announcements and evergreen copy, and work with our design and copywriting team to get assets for our ads placements. Review editorial pieces for accuracy and brand safety.

 - AEO portfolio. Increase the amount of citations on LLM through YouTube partnerships and listicle sponsorships, measuring the impact on citations from your work

 - Account management : being the point of contact for a portfolio of affiliates / creators with large audiences, building win-win deals and generating authentic content.
   


YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS SOMETHING LIKE…

 - 3 years in influencer / affiliate marketing, brand-side or agency side. You’ve worked on significant creator collaborations that had tangible business impact (we’ll ask for example of campaigns you’ve run or a portfolio)

 - A track record of managing a large portfolio of accounts and co-building the systems to support working with hundreds of vendors and deals at once, without sacrificing the quality of deliverables

 - Experience working at a startup or scale up, preferably in tech, AI or B2B SaaS space. You understand the future of work and Granola’s ICP (enterprise and self-serve)


AS A PERSON, YOU…

 - Have high-agency and business acumen. You’re able to autonomously allocate budget, negotiate with creators, unstuck collaborations including at-risk accounts

 - Are AI-native but know when to use it and when it is an overkill

 - Are extremely good at prioritizing - picking what will really move the needles with goals and saying no to what is just busy work

 - Have deep interest, curiosity and understanding around the creator economy and brand partnerships. You know that the playbooks get constantly re-written and you proactively keep up with the industry.

 - Are chronically online and already know partners that would be a great fit for Granola. Bonus if you have existing relationships with creators, publishers and key opinion leaders that would be a great fit for Granola.

 - Are creative and can select creators who have a tasteful editorial line and content style. You’d be able to scout the partners we’d be proud to collaborate with not only through data but also by instincts. Your experience helps you tell who can build trust and influence.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

This is the opportunity to come shape the narrative of Granola with creators while generating measurable growth, on the branding and user acquisition side, and create business impact at one of the fastest growing AI company in London.

We work primarily together in London (office-first). You can find more about the team, how we work and our benefits on our careers page https://www.granola.ai/jobs.

If this sounds like work you’d love doing, we’d like to hear from you—even if your experience doesn’t match every point above.




COMPENSATION

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

postings.title: Product Engineer (Full Stack)
postings.description:
HEY! WE'RE TEAM GRANOLA 👋  

We're building a category-defining product, backed by a $125M Series C and used daily by teams at companies like Cursor, Vanta, and Linear. We started by making meeting notes better. Now we're turning every conversation a company has into context that people and agents can act on. Most of what that means for users hasn't been designed yet.

If you haven't already, you should check out what we're building https://www.granola.ai, and why you should work here https://www.granola.ai/jobs.

The Granola team is kind, curious and design-obsessed. Many of us are former founders, others have built products at Figma, Apple, Google and Meta, and we're all still learning from each other.

You'll own user-facing features end to end: talking to users, deciding what to build, working closely with the Granola team. You'll take ideas from zero to one inside a product people already rely on every day.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Agentic workflows: Turn what was said in a meeting into what gets done. Build the tools and context that let Granola’s agents pick up where the conversation left off.

 - Team workspaces. Help companies build a shared context layer from their most important conversations, while still prioritising user privacy and ownership.

 - The core note experience. Keep AI-enhanced notes accurate and trustworthy, so people rely on them without checking.

 - Prototype, then ship. Ship daily experiments to our internal app for quick feedback, and collaborate with the team and our users to get it to production.

 - New surfaces. Bring Granola to more of the places people work, across desktop, mobile and integrations.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We don't set a minimum number of years. Some of our strongest engineers graduated two years ago; others have run their own companies. We care about what you've built and how you think about it.

 - You've shipped user-facing features end to end, with visible impact on a product, and you can show us.

 - You're strong in TypeScript, React and Node.js, and comfortable down to Postgres and AWS.

 - You have taste: you care about UX, speed and polish, and you push back when something doesn't feel right.

 - You're comfortable shaping the problem, not just building the solution, and you enjoy talking to users to get there.

 - You can take an idea from zero to one: a rough prototype in front of users, then iteration until it's polished.

 - You're curious about building with LLMs. Direct experience with prompts, evals or agents is a bonus, not a requirement.


HOW WE WORK

 - People and product first. We hire people who are kind, down to earth and pragmatic, who care deeply about the product, and who want to stay connected to the customers using it. Product isn't one team's job here; it's everyone's.

 - High autonomy. Engineers spot opportunities and ship improvements themselves. We’d rather you ship it than write about it.

 - Everyone talks to users. Every engineer works directly with the people using Granola, and that's where most of our best ideas come from.

 - A high bar for engineering and product. We expect strong technical ability and strong product sense. Engineers think like PMs: they understand the user's problem and help shape the direction of what they build.

 - Room to experiment. Every engineer has a budget from day one to use new models, tools and technologies which make them more productive.

 - Design and quality matter. Thoughtful design, a high quality bar and close collaboration on everything we build.

 - We work in person, with flexibility. We’re in the office five days a week because we genuinely like building together. It’s relaxed: dress down, bring your dog, and no fixed office hours.

What that looks like in practice: the version of Granola we use internally goes far beyond the public app. We're building at the frontier of agentic software, and we try every new capability on ourselves first.




OUR STACK

TypeScript, React, Node.js, Postgres, AWS and Terraform, plus whichever new models and tools prove themselves. You don't need experience with everything, but you should be excited to work close to users and ship often.





WHAT WE OFFER

We're living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968, and we want to build that future together in London. We pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity. We work together in person five days a week at our office in Old Street, and we offer relocation support if you're moving to London.

Great people come from all kinds of backgrounds. If this speaks to you, whether or not you look like a fit on paper, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: GTM Systems Lead
postings.description:
ABOUT US

We're Team Granola 👋

Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.

We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

 - Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

 - Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com http://Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

 - Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

 - Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

 - Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

 - Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

 - Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

 - Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

 - An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

 - A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

 - Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

 - You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

postings.title: Community Manager (San Francisco)
postings.description:
Hey! We’re team Granola 👋 We’re building the leading AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings, a product that’s spreading through teams and redefining how knowledge is captured and used. We help teams turn messy call notes into structured insight, so they can spend more time focusing on what’s important and less time on admin.



WHY WE CARE ABOUT COMMUNITY

When people find Granola, they tend to really love it. Community is how we bring that feeling offline, into a room with other people who feel the same.

We’ve run 100+ events with more than 5,000 people, starting in London, and learnt a lot about what makes people come back.

In SF, we’ve opened an office and run a number of events, experimenting as we go: our GTM Series, a demo night with Linear, a GTM hackathon with Anthropic and more. Now we’re looking for someone to take it beyond the experimental phase and build a well-oiled machine, known as one of the best places in SF for tech community and events.

We don’t measure community in signups. It’s brand marketing, and it’s how we show people what Granola is like in person.



OUR GOAL

Make Granola one of the best AI-native, human brands for professionals.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

You’ll own generating event ideas and community initiatives and the execution those ideas:

 - Come up with event and community ideas, and think hard about what makes an event special

 - Curate the guest list so a great group of people show up

 - Own all comms with speakers, partners and guests

 - Run logistics like a station master, so everything leaves on time

 - Own the marketing for every event, from the copy to the socials, so the room is full

 - Work closely with our brand and events teams in London, who hold the bar on how Granola shows up

 - Pitch in on big product launches when we need all hands

 - Build relationships with the top accelerators and VCs in the Bay (e.g. YC, Neo, HF0, SPC). Be there when new cohorts land, so Granola is the first tool founders reach for on day one


HOW YOU’LL KNOW IT’S WORKING

 - Within 6 months, people in SF say Granola puts on some of the best tech events in the city

 - Before that:
   
   - Your events fill up are oversubscribed with the relevant folks for each event
   
   - Great event and community ideas keep coming
   
   - You own and run logistics like clockwork


ABOUT YOU

Your background

 - 5+ years in community and events, venture, startup ecosystems or partnerships

 - A track record of running great events for a tech audience consistently

 - Comfortable talking to execs and founders

Bonus points

 - A strong network in Bay Area tech, with relationships across founders, accelerators or VCs

As a person, you

 - Work autonomously. You set direction together with Shre and the team, then run with it. Take feedback well - you get curious, adjust quickly, and show the change in your next piece of work

 - Sweat the details. For every event, you think about the one thing that will make people remember it and feel special. You treat the attendee experience like a user flow: from the moment someone arrives outside our office, to checking in, to knowing where the bathroom is before they have to ask

 - Get startups and tech. You’re always reading, listening and learning about the fastest-growing startups, founders and operators, and you know what founders care about

 - Have great judgment. You come up with original ideas and have the instincts to know what’s right for Granola’s brand. Our bar is high, and you’re always open to learning how to meet it

 - Roll up your sleeves. This is a founding community role. You’re as comfortable emailing a unicorn founder as you are Ubering to a restaurant yourself to pick up pizza boxes if DoorDash is horrendously late to make sure everyone’s fed. No task is beneath you

 - Love being around people. You get energy from meeting people, can work a crowd, and can say no politely but firmly

 - Embody the core Granola traits: hardworking, kind and incredibly ambitious


COMPENSATION

Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, plus equity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart’s demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.
